description: Build ONE unsigned Regen Ledger transaction that retires a small slice of a United States carbon credit from YOUR OWN regen1 account, sized to the minutes of compute you report. Keyless: this tool never signs, never asks for a key and never holds one. You sign and broadcast it yourself with your own wallet, CLI or agent, and you pay the seller in REGEN and your own gas; Vealth holds none of your money and takes no fee. It reads the live Regen marketplace, takes the first REGEN-priced United States ton order, sizes the quantity at 6 grams of CO2e a minute (a rough count by an estimator, not a measurement; one gram is one smallest unit of a credit), checks the cost and your balance, and returns the unsigned buy message with auto-retire on, a bid equal to the ask, and no max fee, plus its bytes read back. Your minutes are your own count and nothing checks them. A retirement is a real, public, permanent claim for the grams it covers; it takes those tons off the market. The order can change before you sign, and a stale bid is refused by the chain. Refuses with a plain reason when the size is too small for the gas, the balance is too low, no such order is open, or a read fails. Cost and signer: this call is free; the retirement is paid by the person from their own wallet, the credit's price and the chain's fee, and the house never holds a key.

address.description: Your OWN regen1... address: the account that will sign, pay and own the retirement. Never send a private key anywhere.

compute_minutes.description: Your own count of minutes of compute to cover, a whole number from 1 to 1440 (one day) a call.

jurisdiction.description: The place the retirement is recorded for: a two-letter country in capitals, or country, a dash and a region, such as US-CA.

reason.description: Optional. Your own words for the retirement record, at most 256 characters, no phone numbers, emails or links. It follows a fixed lead and is written onchain for good.

name: prepare_regen_compute_retirement
title: Prepare a Regen credit retirement sized to your own compute (keyless, you sign)
